contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #211: The geometric phase diagram, diffusion, and spectra of random planar maps.

Finite rooted n-edge planar map and spanning-tree pairs, uniform over pairs, loops and multiplicities retained. Resolve the simultaneous small-source counting-Laplacian Green estimate without geometric or continuum assumptions.

definitions.mu: degree probability deg(v)/(2n), loops counted twice
definitions.Green: H Gf=mu f and mu(Gf)=0 for mu(f)=0; H uses counting measure and one unit conductance per unoriented nonloop edge

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 211 (The geometric phase diagram, diffusion, and spectra of random planar maps.; papers: Random Walks on Critical FK–Ising Maps and Liouville Brownian Motion; Spectral convergence for critical FK–Ising planar maps; A Linear Clock for Random Walk on Tree-Weighted Planar Maps; Canonical conformal limits of subcritical FK planar maps; The critical Liouville quantum sphere and geometric limits of FK maps at q=4; Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps; Brownian continuum random tree limits of finite Fortuin–Kasteleyn maps above four; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/211.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

Proposition gr:green-bound: for every fixed 0<rho<1/2 there exist map-measurable nonnegative A_n with sup_n E A_n<infinity and ||G_n f||_infinity<=A_n mu_n(|f|)^rho simultaneously for all centered real |f|<=1, under the uniform rooted map/spanning-tree pair marginal.

Strengthening: for every 1<p<3 and 0<rho<1-1/p, the same finite ensemble admits map-measurable A_n with sup_n E A_n^p<infinity satisfying the simultaneous small-source Green inequality. Also, for every beta>4/3 there are map-measurable B_n with sup_n E B_n<infinity and ||G_n f||_infinity<=B_n m^(2/3)(1+log(1/m))^beta for all admissible f and 0<m=mu_n(|f|)<=1 (zero source gives zero). Hence every rho<2/3 is allowed with bounded expected constants. No optimality or continuum conclusion is asserted.

In the finite shuffle encoding, fixing a horizontal schedule and horizontal Dyck word fixes the primal vertex visits, their degree masses, and every smaller-side cut interval, including ties. The remaining vertical string is uniform Dyck and independent of those choices. Each cut obeys mu(S)=ell/(2n) and b=1+dual contour distance, with loops and multiplicities retained.

A uniform s-step Dyck contour has deterministic-corner distance density at most C(a+1)^2 d^(-3/2) exp(-c a^2/d), where d=1+min(j,s-j). Thus inverse distance has L^p norm O_p(d^(-1/2)) for 0<p<3, quantitatively O((3-p)^(-1/p)d^(-1/2)) for 2<=p<3, and a deterministic L-step contour segment has diameter L^4 norm O(sqrt(L)).

For the exact smaller-side tour cut sum U_{M,t}, sup over n, dyadic M<=n, and deterministic t of ||U_{M,t}||_p is finite for every 1<p<3; uniformly for 2<=p<3 it is at most C(3-p)^(-1/p). The bound holds without conditioning on a vertical-shape-dependent event.

Universal finite-sum transport: if a potential is an average over finitely many decompositions, each a finite cut sum, and each summand has absolute value at most nonnegative cut weight times a common nonnegative source modulus, then the absolute potential is at most the averaged sum of cut weights times that modulus, at every vertex simultaneously.

Strengthening: for every 1<p<3 and 0<rho<1-1/p, the same finite ensemble admits map-measurable A_n with sup_n E A_n^p<infinity satisfying the simultaneous small-source Green inequality. Also, for every beta>4/3 there are map-measurable B_n with sup_n E B_n<infinity and ||G_n f||_infinity<=B_n m^(2/3)(1+log(1/m))^beta for all admissible f and 0<m=mu_n(|f|)<=1 (zero source gives zero). Hence every rho<2/3 is allowed with bounded expected constants. No optimality or continuum conclusion is asserted.

external_assumptions.statement: Rooted n-edge planar maps with a distinguished spanning tree, allowing loops and multiple edges, are in bijection with shuffles of two Dyck words having total length 2n; tree traversals and non-tree half-edges occur separately at their incident primal vertices.
external_assumptions.source: Olivier Bernardi, Bijective counting of tree-rooted maps and shuffles of parenthesis systems (2007); encoding and inverse in Section 2.
external_assumptions.locator: Section 2, pp. 2-4, correspondence Xi and its reverse mapping

claims.natural_statement: Universal finite-sum transport: if a potential is an average over finitely many decompositions, each a finite cut sum, and each summand has absolute value at most nonnegative cut weight times a common nonnegative source modulus, then the absolute potential is at most the averaged sum of cut weights times that modulus, at every vertex simultaneously.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace FiniteGreen

theorem weighted_cut_transport
    {T E X : Type*} [Fintype T] [Fintype E]
    (prob : T → ℝ) (term : T → E → X → ℝ) (weight : T → E → ℝ)
    (modulus : ℝ)
    (hprob : ∀ t, 0 ≤ prob t)
    (hbound : ∀ t e x, |term t e x| ≤ weight t e * modulus) :
    ∀ x, |∑ t, prob t * ∑ e, term t e x| ≤
      (∑ t, prob t * ∑ e, weight t e) * modulus := by
  intro x
  calc
    |∑ t, prob t * ∑ e, term t e x| ≤
        ∑ t, |prob t * ∑ e, term t e x| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ t, prob t * |∑ e, term t e x| := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hprob t)]
    _ ≤ ∑ t, prob t * ∑ e, weight t e * modulus := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro t ht
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hprob t)
      exact (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
        (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun e he => hbound t e x))
    _ = (∑ t, prob t * ∑ e, weight t e) * modulus := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]

theorem simultaneous_cut_transport
    {F T E X : Type*} [Fintype T] [Fintype E]
    (admissible : F → Prop) (prob : T → ℝ)
    (term : F → T → E → X → ℝ) (weight : T → E → ℝ)
    (modulus : F → ℝ)
    (hprob : ∀ t, 0 ≤ prob t)
    (hbound : ∀ f, admissible f → ∀ t e x,
      |term f t e x| ≤ weight t e * modulus f) :
    ∀ f, admissible f → ∀ x,
      |∑ t, prob t * ∑ e, term f t e x| ≤
        (∑ t, prob t * ∑ e, weight t e) * modulus f := by
  intro f hf
  exact weighted_cut_transport prob (term f) weight (modulus f)
    hprob (hbound f hf)

theorem overlapping_small_sides_do_not_cover
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (mu : V → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ v, 0 < mu v)
    (hnorm : ∑ v, mu v = 1)
    (S R : Finset V)
    (hS : ∑ v ∈ S, mu v ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2)
    (hR : ∑ v ∈ R, mu v ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2)
    (x : V) (hxS : x ∈ S) (hxR : x ∈ R) :
    S ∪ R ≠ Finset.univ := by
  intro hcover
  have hlower : mu x ≤ ∑ v ∈ S ∩ R, mu v :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun v hv => (hpos v).le)
      (Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hxS, hxR⟩)
  have hid := Finset.sum_union_inter S R mu
  rw [hcover, hnorm] at hid
  linarith [hpos x]

end FiniteGreen
